Nasha Mukt Bihar 2026 : Bihar men nashamukt bihar abhiyan 2026 ka shubharanbh ho gaya hai. CM Samrat Choudhary ne Patna men abhiyan ki shuruaat ki. is pahal ka uddeshy nashe ke khilaph jagrukta barhana aur logon ko nashamukt jivan ke lie prerit karna hai.
Bihar sarkar ke is abhiyan se juri har bari apdet, CM Samrat Choudhary ke sandesh aur Bihar ki taja khabron ke lie hamare chainal se jure rahen.
